preconditions.description: n is the number of nodes in the complete binary tree (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^9), and m is the number of extra edges (0 ≤ m ≤ 4).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(u) <= int(n) and 1 <= int(v) <= int(n) and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each extra edge (u, v) connects distinct nodes within the valid range [1, n].
The number of extra edges provided matches the input m.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of simple paths in the graph (tree + extra edges) modulo 10^9 + 7, where a simple path is a sequence of distinct nodes connected by edges, including single-node paths.
